title: DEPARTMENT’S REPORT dated September 3, 2026, relative to a donation valued at $7,200.00 to
text:
[3. CONSENT AGENDA ITEMS]
DEPARTMENT’S REPORT dated September 3, 2026, relative to a donation valued at $7,200.00 to
  acquire a new Quarter Horse Gelding “Jensen” to join the Mounted Platoon, as set forth.
  [BPC #26-269]
  Recommendation(s) for Board action:

  APPROVE the Department’s report.
summary: Approval of $7,200 donation to acquire a Quarter Horse for the Mounted Platoon.
